calls.title: Sync on Remaining Legacy Experiment Flows
calls.summary: The team focused on streamlining the experiment creation process by shifting to a one-step flow, asking only for basic metadata initially, while further setup is done on the overview page. Discussion included the redesign needs for the feature flag rule experiment flow, addressing user preferences for simpler scheduling options. Differences between rule scheduling and experiment scheduling were clarified, emphasizing the value added by experiment scheduling. User experience concerns were raised about navigating new flows, and the need for clear communication was highlighted. Additionally, the team looked into template usage trends, identified technical challenges like incomplete identifier mapping, and proposed immediate next steps for redesign and collaboration with UX teams.
calls.keywords: experiment creation, feature flag, scheduling, pre-launch checklist, experiment templates, user experience
